note: Finance data requirements catalogue for banks. For each way a GL balance is backed, the source attributes it needs, why, and the data quality rule that proves them. The register is generated from this file, the reference chart and the map rules; nothing here is client data.

every_account.why: The balance itself, signed debit positive, per ledger and period end
every_account.dq_rule: Each entity's trial balance nets to zero (check 9.7)

every_account.attribute: fct_gl_balance segments (entity, natural account, cost centre, business line, product, credit stage, intercompany)
every_account.why: Statutory, management and segment views all read the same balance at full segment grain
every_account.dq_rule: Every segment value is a member of its dimension; unassigned members are explicit, never blank

every_account.why: The canonical concept gives the IFRS and US GAAP line and XBRL tag
every_account.dq_rule: Every posting account in use carries a concept (check 9.3)

common.why: Identifies the instrument so every GL amount can be traced to it
common.dq_rule: Unique per source system; every contract has its product subtype row (check 9.1)

common.why: Gives the instrument's Entity, BusinessLine and Product segments
common.dq_rule: Never null; business line is assigned for every income-bearing contract

common.why: Positions are taken at the same period end, ledger and currency as the GL
common.dq_rule: One position per contract, date and ledger

CARRYING.why: Amortised cost or carrying value, routed to the product's balance sheet account
CARRYING.dq_rule: Positions through the map rules equal the GL to the cent (check 9.5)

CARRYING.why: Components of carrying amount for the effective interest method and disclosure
CARRYING.dq_rule: principal + accrued interest - unamortised fee = carrying amount

CARRYING.why: AC, FVOCI or FVTPL decides measurement and the statement line

ALLOWANCE.why: Expected credit loss allowance, routed to the allowance account
Gives the CreditStage segment for IFRS 9 staging disclosure
ALLOWANCE.dq_rule: Stage 1, 2, 3 or POCI for every amortised cost and FVOCI loan

ALLOWANCE.why: ECL inputs, needed for overlays and for the US GAAP CECL difference
ALLOWANCE.dq_rule: ECL = PD x LGD x EAD within the model's tolerance

FV_POSITIVE.why: Positive fair values go to derivative assets
FV_POSITIVE.dq_rule: Fair value is from an approved price or model, with its level in the fair value hierarchy

FV_NEGATIVE.why: Negative fair values go to derivative liabilities
FV_NEGATIVE.dq_rule: Fair value is from an approved price or model, with its level in the fair value hierarchy

ifrs17_group.why: IFRS 17 measures by group of contracts, not by policy
ifrs17_group.dq_rule: Every policy belongs to exactly one group

ifrs17_group.why: LRC plus LIC per group is the insurance contract balance
ifrs17_group.dq_rule: Groups through the map rules equal the GL to the cent (check 9.6)

ifrs17_group.why: Disclosure of the liability's building blocks (memo concepts, not accounts)
ifrs17_group.dq_rule: BEL + RA + CSM = LRC for GMM groups

event.why: Income and expense come from instrument events (accruals, fees, write-offs), so P&L traces to contracts
event.dq_rule: Every journal carries its source event; journals balance per event (check 9.2)

event.why: Event journals post at full segment grain, so segment P&L needs no allocation for direct income
event.dq_rule: Every journal combination exists in the GL (check 9.4)

gl.attribute: Journal source and approver for manual entries
gl.why: Balances with no instrument behind them are owned at GL level and need an owner
gl.dq_rule: Every manual or top-side journal has a reason code and an approver

gl.attribute: Driver values for allocation (FTE, transactions, space)
gl.why: Costs reach segments through approved allocation rules, not by hand
gl.dq_rule: Allocated totals equal the pool to the cent
